result.summary: The page is generally polished, but several horizontally scrolling elements are visibly clipped at the right edge, making content appear cut off and reducing clarity about what is interactively scrollable.

issues.description: The third restaurant card in the “Fastest near you” carousel is cut off by the right edge, with the restaurant name visibly truncated (“Trattoria Piccol…”).
issues.suggestion: Add clearer horizontal-carousel affordance, such as a peek indicator or fade, and ensure cards have appropriate snap spacing and clipping behavior. If the carousel is not intended to scroll, fit the cards within the viewport.

issues.description: The category chip row also ends with a partially visible, cut-off chip on the right edge.
issues.suggestion: Provide consistent horizontal padding and a scroll cue, or adjust the chip sizing/layout so the final visible item does not look accidentally truncated.

issues.description: The lower restaurant content appears to continue behind the fixed bottom navigation, leaving the second promotional card partially obscured at the bottom of the viewport.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom content padding equal to the navigation bar height so cards can be fully viewed above the fixed navigation when scrolling.
